review.opening: Your preparation was right: flask at the pull and Inner Fire up 100% of the fight. This one is about lasting to the end.

fixFirst.title: Died at 3:20 to Flame Breath
fixFirst.why: A dead healer heals nothing for the rest of the pull, and Flame Breath is damage you can step out of. You were also out of mana when it landed, so there was no answer left.
fixFirst.drillText: Before the pull, pick a spot in range of the tank and out of anything the boss breathes or cleaves. When damage lands on you, move first and finish the cast after.

links.sentence: You died while out of mana.

thenFix.title: Out of mana from 3:05
thenFix.why: The mana ran out 15 s before the death; the fix is upstream, in how you spend it.

thenFix.title: Greater Heal (Rank 4): 44% overheal
thenFix.why: Top Holy priests here overheal 22% with this rank. A lower rank costs less mana, and that is where your last 15 s went.

links.sentence: Greater Heal (Rank 4) is your most-cast heal with the most overheal.
